source.title: The Tolman-Eichenbaum Machine: Unifying Space and Relational Memory through Generalization in the Hippocampal Formation

confidence_rationale: Strong model+data convergence: a single generative model reproduces grid/place/band/object-vector cell phenomenology AND generalises relational structure to novel environments, recovering empirically recorded representations. Directly grounds the L2 'cognitive map = general relational inference engine' premise behind ARC-091. Tempered by being a model whose biological claims are inferential rather than directly recorded.
failure_signatures: If the hippocampal-entorhinal map were purely spatial (not a reusable relational structure), REE's 'state-as-navigable relational package, inferable across structurally-equivalent situations' framing would lose its biological warrant; TEM shows structural knowledge factorises and transfers.

mapping.source_claim_statement: A factorised generative model (TEM) that separates structural knowledge (where/how things relate) from sensory experience reproduces hippocampal-entorhinal cell types and, crucially, generalises learned relational structure to new environments -- formalising the hippocampal formation as a relational-memory / cognitive-map system, not a purely spatial one.
mapping.ree_translation: Grounds INF-7/ARC-091's 'state as navigable relational situation' and the map-generalisation failure axis (map-over/under-generalisation). The structure/content factorisation is the biology behind REE's claim that inference reuses a relational map to answer 'where am I in this relational space, and what unseen relation follows?' -- and that over- vs under-transfer of that map (oversplit/overmerge in MECH-126 terms) are the failure modes.
mapping.mapping_caveat: TEM is a normative model fit to data, not a lesion/causal demonstration that the brain performs this factorisation; and REE does not implement TEM. The mapping is at the level of shared computational principle (factorised relational generalisation), so transfer risk lies in assuming REE's L-space inherits the same generalisation properties.
mapping.source_context: Computational model trained on structured tasks; compared against rodent entorhinal/hippocampal recordings and non-spatial relational-inference tasks.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality high (Cell, landmark unifying model). Mapping fidelity high for the relational-inference framing and the map-generalisation failure axis; transfer risk moderate because it is a model, not a causal recording.
